## In our context

::: {.tip}
- Stress vs load in the elastic range is close to linear — a good first model and a sanity check
- The fit predicts the **mean**; a safety assessment needs a margin: look at residuals and prediction intervals, not only R²
- Check residuals against each input: a pattern means missing physics (plasticity, contact, geometry effects)
:::
